summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state set and cleared in the run entry point (run_app inside run()). Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 11 tests; all pass when run against this repo's src via PYTHONPATH (the venv's editable textual points at another directory, so plain pytest tests the wrong source). The timeout test catches either concurrent.futures.TimeoutError or asyncio.TimeoutError, because on Python 3.9 the bridge converts the class. Full suite excluding snapshot, cli and devtools: 616 passed, 68 failed; the failures I checked are all 'async def functions are not natively supported' (pytest-asyncio missing from the venv). cli and devtools don't collect because click and aiohttp are missing. Nothing committed; no packages installed or venv changed.
